scoring_justification: The checker recomputes m_d_star, tau, and PF from the input columns (n_e, mu_Hall, S) using the single-parabolic-band model with Fermi integrals (r=0.5, T=300 K). Agent's values are compared to these recomputed values with relative tolerances (0.5% for m_d_star, 1% for tau and PF), ensuring genuine numerical solution. A trend check verifies that τ(Sr) > τ(all other compositions), matching the paper's phase diagram. T1 is fully feasible because all formulas are deterministic and only require the input data the agent must output.

outputs.description: Input transport data (composition, n_e, mu_Hall, S) and the computed density-of-states effective mass (m_d_star), carrier relaxation time (tau), and thermoelectric power factor (PF) for 15 compositions.

output_contract.notes: The checker will recompute the derived quantities (m_d_star, tau, PF) from the provided input columns; tolerances are hidden.
